text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A piece of fan mail
arrived for Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my. Isn't this
a huge leap toward Marchan becoming a world-famous mascot?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's written here? Could it be
about how lovely Chan-me is, after all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan began reading the letter after saying that,
but—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: Was there something bad in it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No, Trainer, it's not like that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The letter says... 'I find myself thinking about
how hard you always try, Machan, over and over.'"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “‘Whenever I fail and feel down, I remember the way Chan-ma runs.’”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Because doing that makes me feel like I need to work just as hard
and keep pushing forward too..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "‘Seeing Mar-chan run is my lucky charm――’"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Keep it on you at all times, your Amulet-chan.
...Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan just wanted you
to remember Mar-chan, though..."
choice_data_list: Isn't that what making an impression is all about?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that the image left in someone's memory
can continue to move their heart indefinitely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The Chan in their memories...
will move that person's heart...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. That, too,
might be the duty of a world-famous mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's clear, Trainer.
We've gotta give today's training our all!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I need this person to remember
a harder-working Chan-Me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Aston Machan began
devoting herself to training even more intensely.
